dct_description_sm: This is a cooperative project between a number of wildlife agencies and Boards to use satellite radio-collars on Porcupine Caribou to document the seasonal range use and migration patterns of the herd. The herd's total home range is approximately 260,000 km2, between Kaktovik, Alaska to Aklavik, NWT to Dawson City, Yukon. Most of this very large area is used quite often by the herd, however use of specific areas (other than during calving) is not always predictable.
dct_title_s: Porcupine Caribou Herd Satellite Collar Project, Eastern North Slope, Alaska and Yukon
